caption: The drawing features a detailed illustration of a wall-mounted candlestick holder. In the lower section, a three-dimensional, colored rendering shows the object in shades of brass and gold, depicting a round wall plate with concentric circles and a cylindrical base from which a curved and ornate arm extends forward, ending in a candle socket with a flared drip plate. The upper section of the drawing contains two technical, line-drawn views of the same object: a front elevation and a side elevation, both without coloring, showing the form and structure with clarity. A small ruler indicating inches is placed centrally beneath the technical views for scale reference. The artist's name, "James O'Mara," is written in the bottom right corner of the drawing, which is surrounded by a rectangular border. The paper has a yellowed tone, indicating age.
title: Bracket Sconce
cluster: #16 — Lighting Devices: Lamps, Lanterns, and Candleholders
